info.name: Cairn
info.summary: Read-only view of your Cairn health files
info.description:
Cairn is a personal health-data aggregator. A phone app reads the platform health store (Apple HealthKit / Android Health Connect), normalises readings into open Open mHealth / IEEE 1752.1 JSON-Lines files, and syncs them into your own Nextcloud. Those files are the system of record — there is no central server and no proprietary database.
This app is an optional second frontend over exactly those files. It reads `/Cairn/` from your own storage, aggregates server-side, and renders the result.
It never writes. It creates no folders, stores nothing in the database, runs no background job, and registers no route other than GET. Deleting it loses nothing, because it owns nothing.
info.author: Max Fiedler
